name: Fake QR codes
how: A sticker with a scammer's QR code is placed over a shop's real one, or sent to you in a chat.
signs: The receiving name doesn't match the shop.
protect: Always check the account name before you confirm a payment.

name: Fake bank messages
how: An SMS or email says your account is locked and asks you to click a link to "verify".
signs: Urgent tone, strange links, requests for OTP codes.
protect: Banks never ask for your OTP or password. Open your bank app directly instead of the link.

name: "Easy job, high pay"
how: Online tasks like liking videos pay small amounts at first, then ask you to "deposit" money to unlock bigger tasks.
signs: You must pay to earn. Pay that's too good for simple work.
protect: A real job never asks you to send money first.

name: Fake delivery calls
how: Someone claiming to be a shipper asks you to pay for a package you never ordered.
signs: You don't remember ordering anything. Pressure to pay fast.
protect: Check your order history in the shopping app before paying anything.

name: Instant loan apps
how: Apps promise quick loans with no paperwork, then charge huge fees and harass your contacts.
signs: Asks for access to your contacts and photos. Unclear interest rates.
protect: Only borrow from licensed banks. Talk to family or your school first.
